'''mwod Shmi Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mwod]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Slave Quarters
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 TSQ mwod LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Leia (V), Flash Of Insight (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Shmi deck.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3); Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5).
* Qty 61 as published: the Weapons header says 1 but lists 2 lightsabers.
* No objective; starts Tatooine: Slave Quarters. Your Insight Serves You Well (starting section) is the Effect. Posted 'i must speak with the jedi council' dested Speak With The Jedi Council; Obi-wan's lightsaber dested the Premiere Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.

== Strategy ==

first turn: get shmi from deck. pull threepio.

use threepio.

set up your hand and battle them.

easy. awesome too.
